sloka: राघवश्चापि विपुलं तं राक्षसवनौकसाम्।श्रुत्वा सङ्ग्रामनिर्घोषं जाम्बवन्तमुवाच ह ।। ६.८३.१ ।।
transliteration: rāghavaścāpi vipulaṁ taṁ rākṣasavanaukasām।śrutvā saṅgrāmanirghoṣaṁ jāmbavantamuvāca ha ।। 6.83.1 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the great noise of war between Rakshasas and Vanaras, Rama said to Jambavantha.
